mechanism: Paroxetine inhibits CYP2D6, which metabolizes deutetrabenazine to its active metabolites, potentially increasing deutetrabenazine exposure and adverse effects including QT prolongation and serotonergic effects.
action: Monitor for increased deutetrabenazine adverse effects (akathisia, parkinsonism, depression); consider dose adjustment of deutetrabenazine or alternative antidepressant with less CYP2D6 inhibition; baseline and periodic ECG monitoring recommended.
